body.statement: Can one construct a uniform liminf and recovery comparison between the exact eight-type orbit games and the stratified face/corner experiment, with risk error \(o(n^{-4/3})\), simultaneously for \(|\eta|\le\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{bridge}}\), the coalesced fiber \(\eta=0\), every mixture on the \(000\)--\(111\) nuisance edge, every zero-likelihood observation cell, and every dormant finite-game primal constraint? The comparison must justify measure-valued concentration on \(\eta=0\), continuity of the fiber wavefunction and its \(\theta\)-derivative at \(\theta=\pm|\eta|/2\), and absence of an artificial \(\eta\)-diffusion or \(\eta\)-boundary condition.
body.justification: This is the genuine unresolved proof boundary separating a compelling formal constant from a theorem valid for the full labelled finite experiment.
body.gap: Appendix C of Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026) controls a one-dimensional lattice, while the prior orbit proposal permits arbitrary versions on null cells; neither result supplies uniform singular-fiber recovery.
body.consumer: Closing the bridge validates the sharp constant, the allocation frontier, and the finite certificates simultaneously; failure pinpoints the first labelled orbit that requires a different limit experiment.

obligation.what_is_open: A full fiberwise primal-and-dual recovery theorem uniformly for every |eta| <= epsilon_n^bridge, beyond the proved global minimax-value comparison.
obligation.obstruction: The available dual construction is least-favorable and concentrates at eta=0; it does not furnish dual recovery uniformly across the entire eta band. The value-level theorem is sufficient for every current binary and bounded headline.
obligation.attempted: A solver wrapper was rejected after high-effort adjudication because it only cited thm:uniform-singular-value-bridge and overstated eta-uniformity. Do not dispatch this residual again unless a future directive supplies a genuinely fiberwise dual construction.
obligation.partial_result: thm:uniform-singular-value-bridge proves the required two-sided global minimax-value transfer, with primal control uniform over complete schedules and a dual prior concentrating at eta=0, while retaining null cells and dormant constraints.
